bibl.title: Colloquy of Moses on Mt. Sinai
The Colloquy of Moses on Mount Sinai

noteGrp.note: An anonymous Syriac dialogue between Moses and God on Mount Sinai. Moses poses a series of questions and God answers them, with the dialogue addressing legal and ethical matters as well as questions about God’s origin and nature.

note.quote: ܬܘܒ ܡܐܕܪܫ ܒܚܝܠ ܐܝܬܘܬܐ ܡܫܪܐ ܥܒܕܐ ܡܠܐ ܚܜܝܬܐ ܠܡܟܬܒ ܗܕܐ ܬܫܠܝܬܐ ܕܡܘܫܐ ܒܚܝܪ ܒܐܒܝܘܬܐ
Once again, in the strength of the Being, the servant full of sin begins t0 write this Narrative of Moses the Elect in Prophecy
ܫܠܡܬ ܬܫܥܝܬܐ ܕܡܪܝ ܡܘܫܐ ܡܖܝ ܡܢ ܐܝܕܝ ܡܚܝܠܐ ܘܚܜܝܐ ܩܫܝܫܐ ܙܪܘܢܕܐ ܒܪ ܐܚܐ ܕܡܪܝ ܝܘܚܢܢ ܨܠܘ ܫܝܜܘܬܝ ܐܡܝܢ
Ends the Narrative of Mar Moses, by the hands of the weak and sinful priest Zerwanda, son of the brother of Mar Yohanan. Pray for my contemptibility. Amen
